name: MedusaJS
description: Medusa is an open-source commerce platform built on Node.js. It ships the commerce modules, a Store and Admin REST API and an admin dashboard, and is extended in TypeScript with custom modules, workflows, subscribers and API routes.

notes.text: The admin dashboard is served by Medusa itself at http://IP:9000/app. The generated admin login, along with the PostgreSQL credentials, is in /root/medusajs.creds.

STORE_CORS, ADMIN_CORS and AUTH_CORS are set to the container IP. Add every origin that will reach the API, including a reverse-proxy hostname or a storefront URL, or the browser will block the requests.

Cookies are configured with sameSite lax and secure false, because Medusa's production defaults refuse to authenticate over plain HTTP on an IP address. Tighten cookieOptions in medusa-config.ts once TLS fronts the container.

The database is seeded with the starter's default sales channel, publishable API key, regions and demo catalog. The demo products are safe to delete; the sales channel and the publishable key are not, as the Store API needs them.

Medusa is headless and a framework rather than a finished store: no storefront is installed, and custom modules, workflows and API routes go in /opt/medusajs/apps/backend/src. Changes there need a rebuild (pnpm exec medusa build) and a service restart.
Updates bump the @medusajs packages, run migrations and rebuild, leaving your own src untouched. Minor Medusa releases may carry breaking changes, so read the release notes before updating.
